morphology.pattern_note: se-读作/sə/；词根开头的/i/保留，形成元音相接。此处表示记忆所及的范围。

senses.zh_definition: 据某人所记得的；在某人的记忆范围内。
senses.en_definition: As far as someone remembers; to the best of someone's recollection.
senses.nuances: 通常接表示记忆主体的代词或名词，如seingat saya。限定陈述的依据为记忆，容许日后更正，但不表示说话者一定记不清。不同于表示突然想起的teringat。[DBP词条：seingat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=seingat)

collocations.en: to the best of our recollection

dual_scenarios.context: 职场会议 / 汇报先前讨论
dual_scenarios.ms: Seingat saya, perkara itu telah dibincangkan dalam mesyuarat yang lalu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 据我所记得的，这件事已在上次会议中讨论过。
dual_scenarios.en: To the best of my recollection, that matter was discussed at the previous meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Seingat aku, kunci tu kat atas meja je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Seingat saya, kunci itu di atas meja sahaja.
dual_scenarios.en: If I remember right, the keys are just on the table.
spoken_features: aku用于熟人之间的非正式自称

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Seingat aku, kunci tu kat atas meja je.
messages.ms_standard: Seingat saya, kunci itu di atas meja sahaja.
messages.en: If I remember right, the keys are just on the table.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya sudah menjumpai kunci itu. Terima kasih!

etymology.historical_story: Seingat combines se- with ingat, the word associated with remembering. Its dictionary meaning places a boundary around a claim: only as far as someone's memory reaches. In conversation, this becomes a useful way to revisit an earlier event while allowing correction. The connection between memory and limited certainty provides a clearer learning story than an unsupported account of its first historical appearance.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住ingat“记得”：seingat saya就是“在我记得的范围内”。把se-想成圈住记忆范围的小圆圈。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在会议或与长辈交谈时，seingat saya语气较审慎，也可用于温和提出不同记忆；熟人间可说seingat aku。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合回忆日期、安排和往事。需要精确核实时，可补充Saya akan menyemak rekod terlebih dahulu，表示会先查阅记录。
